tickets.subject: Conveyor Belt B speed issue - Zone B
tickets.description: Zone B conveyor belt running at 60% capacity. Motor sensor showing fault code E-14. Maintenance team notified but parts needed.

tickets.subject: WMS login timeout - Shift supervisor terminals
tickets.description: Supervisor terminals timing out after 5 minutes instead of 30 minutes. Session config updated in Softeon admin panel - pending verification.

tickets.subject: Label printer LP-03 intermittent paper jam
tickets.description: LP-03 jamming every 50-60 labels. Printer cleaned but issue persists. May need roller replacement.

tickets.subject: RF Scanner RF-07 not connecting to WMS
tickets.description: RF-07 unable to authenticate to Softeon WMS. Root cause: expired certificate. Certificate renewed and scanner reconfigured.
